title: The constraint is the ground, not the rocket
imageAlt: The constraint is the ground, not the rocket
summary: Everyone is funding launch vehicles. Almost nobody is funding the ground they launch from — and that is where the bottleneck actually sits.

title: Memoranda of understanding in place for Ghana and the Philippines
imageAlt: Concept render of a Nexus launch pad
summary: Phase 2 and Phase 3 sites are now at memorandum-of-understanding and site-selection stage, extending the network across two continents and both hemispheres.

title: Morrumbene site reserved — 2,000 hectares on the Inhambane coast
imageAlt: Concept masterplan of the Morrumbene launch complex, Mozambique
summary: Two thousand hectares of Mozambican coastline are now reserved as the Phase 1 site, with the full launch complex planned around it.
